jobs.description:
• Our client is an established property developer expanding its residential portfolio in Luxembourg, with a focus on well-designed, energy-efficient homes.
• Its local team combines an entrepreneurial working environment with the expertise and resources of a wider development group.
• Working closely with local management, you will have direct involvement in sales activity and the opportunity to contribute ideas that support commercial growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive sales across a portfolio of residential developments, advising both owner-occupiers and property investors.
• Understand buyers' priorities, budgets and investment objectives to recommend suitable properties.
• Convert enquiries into qualified opportunities through proactive prospecting, consistent follow-up and personalised advice.
• Lead property viewings, project presentations and sales meetings, guiding clients through the purchasing process.
• Build referral relationships with local agents, notaries, investors and other property professionals.
• Coordinate with marketing on lead generation, campaigns and events to support sales conversion.
• Monitor market trends, buyer demand and competing developments to identify commercial opportunities.
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline records and performance reporting.
• Depending on your experience and interests, contribute to partnerships and the identification of potential development acquisitions.

• At least three years of relevant real estate sales experience, preferably involving new-build residential property.
• A sound understanding of the Luxembourg property market; an existing local network would be an advantage.
• Excellent French and professional working proficiency in English. Luxembourgish, German or Dutch would be an asset.
• The ability to tailor your advice to both lifestyle-driven buyers and investment-focused clients.
• A proactive approach to prospecting, supported by commercial drive and disciplined follow-through.
• Professional communication, discretion and the ability to build trust throughout a significant purchasing decision.
• Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with management and marketing.
• An interest in developing your contribution beyond individual property transactions.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

jobs.occupation: Senior Portfolio Manager - Brussels - Private Banking
jobs.description:

• Manage and monitor investment portfolios for high-net-worth clients
• Develop and implement investment strategies aligned with client objectives and risk profiles
• Work closely with relationship managers to support client advisory activities

• Participate in investment committees and contribute to strategic decisions

can you recognise yourself in this?

 People Strategy Develop and implement a comprehensive People & Culture strategy covering talent acquisition, talent development, succession planning, retention, and engagement.Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Partner with recruitment teams to anticipate workforce needs, strengthen employer branding initiatives, and ensure an outstanding candidate experience.Culture & Employee Engagement Promote a strong organizational culture and implement initiatives that enhance employee engagement, well-being, and overall workplace experience.Learning & Development Drive learning strategies, identify development opportunities, and support employees and managers in achieving their full potential.Change Management & Communication Support organizational transformation projects, facilitate effective communication, and ensure alignment between business priorities and people initiatives.People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the People team, fostering collaboration, accountability, empowerment, and high performance.People Analytics & Performance Track HR metrics and KPIs, analyze trends, and recommend data-driven actions that improve business performance and employee experience.

 You bring:

Van Heyghen Staal is a modern steel service center located in Evergem, in the Ghent canal zone near the Port of Ghent. Founded in 1981, the company processes around 250,000 tons of steel plates per year on its cut-to-length and slitting lines, and supplies hot-rolled sheets, plates and slit coils to clients across Europe in a wide range of sectors. Its strong position in the European market is built on quality, innovation, service and just-in-time delivery. To support its automated production lines and upcoming projects, Van Heyghen Staal is looking for a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics.

Jobomschrijving

Job descriptionAs a Junior Industrial Engineer in Electromechanics, you will start with an extensive learning program in which you will get to know our activities and automated lines in detail. You will build expertise in technology, processes and concepts. After this onboarding period, you can grow within Maintenance, Operations or Projects, depending on your interests and talents.

• Managing spare parts and helping plan preventive and corrective maintenance.
• Analyzing breakdowns and developing sustainable solutions.
• Actively contributing to investment and innovation projects.
• Coaching and supporting the technical team so that production runs continuously and optimally.
• Taking part in a rotation to coordinate Saturday maintenance approximately every 6 weeks.
• Contributing to digitalization and automation projects.
• Supporting energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.
• Monitoring and improving technical safety procedures.
• Involvement in a production line renewal project.

Profile

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Electromechanics.
• Preferably at least 3 years of experience, but motivated starters are also welcome (junior profile with some experience).
• Broad technical interest: mechanics, pneumatics, electronics, hydraulics and electricity.
• Hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented.
• Knowledge of automation, drive technology and technical drawing is a plus.
• Good command of English is essential; additional languages

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

• You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
• You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
• You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
• You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.
 

What do we expect from you?

• You have a valid Category C driving licence.
• Code 95 is NOT required.
• You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
• You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.
Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!
